cohort.assets: 277 USDT-M perps (>=200 daily bars), imported data/rc_futures_v1 archive copy; includes delisted/renamed early-stoppers
cohort.price_basis: csv close as the mark proxy for every symbol
cohort.targets: label.forward_return_5d_bps (5d gross close-to-close) plus close-series-derived 10d forward return, MFE_10d and MAE_10d

definitions.dfh20: precomputed feature: close / max(close[i-20:i]) - 1 (strictly prior 20 contiguous bars)
definitions.funding_pct: per-asset mid-rank pct of last_funding_rate vs its trailing-180 daily values (MIN_WINDOW=20); tercile cutoffs fixed at 1/3 and 2/3; funded subset only (~52 syms)
definitions.gate: BTC close/close[t-20]-1 > 0 on the decision day; analysis set = gate-ON asset-days (gate-off reported as context only)
definitions.mae_10d_bps: min(close[t+1..t+10])/close[t]-1 in bps; same contiguity requirement
definitions.mfe_10d_bps: max(close[t+1..t+10])/close[t]-1 in bps; requires 10 contiguous forward daily bars
definitions.pullback: -0.12 <= dfh20 <= -0.03 AND close > previous contiguous day's close
definitions.xs_tercile: mid-rank pct of the feature among assets with non-null values on the same decision day (>=30 assets required): top >= 2/3, bottom <= 1/3

purpose: T117: measure entry STATES for a rolling-compounding long campaign on the mega cohort — 'when to start rolling'. Within BTC-trend-up days (gate = BTC close ret20 > 0 from data/rc_futures_v1/BTC/BTCUSDT_1d.csv), score each asset-day on PIT-computable state dimensions (dfh20 XS tercile, pullback/extended/breaking states, funding_pct tercile on the funded subset, vol20 XS tercile) and report per-cell fwd 5d/10d returns plus 10d MFE/MAE path stats. Welch contrasts under a <=10-cell BH-FDR family; per-year folds for the top-3 cells; verdict ranks cells by mean_fwd10 x MFE/|MAE| and recommends a composite entry rule. Measurement only — no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

caveats: pooled Welch treats same-day cross-asset returns as independent; they share market beta — nominal only
MFE/MAE are close-to-close extrema, not intrabar; liq-relevant wicks are invisible at 1d granularity
state cells overlap (an asset-day can be pullback AND vol_low); cells are not a partition
universe composition changes as symbols list/delist; early stop = delisted OR renamed proxy
second-hand archive copy, not an as-of vintage
statistics.cells: n, mean, median, pos_frac per column; n_path = asset-days with the full 10d contiguous window
statistics.contrasts: pooled Welch two-sample t on asset-day returns, 5 named contrasts x {5d,10d} = 10-cell family
statistics.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg alpha=0.05 over the 10 contrast cells
statistics.folds: per-calendar-year means for the top-3 quality-ranked cells (n >= 200, n_path >= 150)
